connector.name: DevOps On-Premises
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for on-prem Azure DevOps: repos, pull requests, work items, and wiki.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-devops-onpremise. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zwitbaum account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
